lines.text: Meet Jeffi Stores: the easiest way to sell online in India.
Tell us about your business once. Your products, your contacts, your social pages, and even the licences your category needs.
Then pick a look you love, from minimalist and brutalist to glass, luxury or playful, and our AI designs every page of your store.
In a hurry? Pick a ready-made theme, and your store fills it in instantly.
Make it yours with drag and drop. Move sections, edit text and photos, or simply ask the AI for a change.
Your customers get a fast, beautiful store on every device, from search to checkout.
Behind the scenes, one admin runs it all: products, orders, delivery, payments and GST invoices.
When you're ready to grow, campaigns on email, WhatsApp and SMS bring your customers back.
Just need a website for your business? Showcase builds a beautiful one-page site, free for the first month.
Jeffi Stores. Sell anything. We run the store.
